methods.name: reward
methods.desc:
Credit read revenue to the answer that currently holds the slot.
The edge batches paid reads and settles them here in one payment, so a 1,000 uALGO read never pays a chain fee. The credit raises the answer's accumulator and backers pull their share with `claim`; nobody is iterated over.

methods.name: claim
methods.desc:
Pay the sender the read revenue accrued on the answer they back.
Principal is untouched; this only settles the reward side. A later unstake still returns the stake (with the top-exit fee if they hold the slot).
